02
Code blocks

Language (and file when known) on the head with Wrap and Copy, line numbers from 6 lines up, syntax colour, a long line scrolls under a fade instead of being cut mid-word.

cuts lines

Start it with a volume so the index survives a restart:

bash
docker run -p 6333:6333 -p 6334:6334 \  -v $(pwd)/qdrant_storage:/qdrant/storage \  qdrant/qdrant:v1.15.2
python · setup.py
from qdrant_client import QdrantClient, models client = QdrantClient(url="http://localhost:6333")client.create_collection("docs", vectors_config=models.VectorParams(size=384, distance=models.Distance.COSINE))# 384 matches all-MiniLM-L6-v2
03
Headings, lists, inline code

Heading weight and rhythm, numbers in mono, round bullets, inline code as a small sunk chip that reads on tinted bubbles.

Worth your attention

  • Railway asked every customer to rotate passwords and API keys on Oct 21.
  • A new sign-in on your work Google account Sunday at 11:03 PM. Confirm it was you.
  • Rivers Lawn shows $89.19 unpaid for invoice 23465.

Then, to run it locally:

  1. Start the container with a volume.
  2. Create a collection sized to the model (384 for MiniLM).
  3. Point the client at localhost:6333.
